caption:
Three mistakes that get tourist visas refused — and the fee is non-refundable.

One: a large deposit landing days before you apply. Officers read sudden money as borrowed money.

Two: reservation dates that do not match your application dates. One mismatch and the whole file loses credibility.

Three: no evidence you are coming back. They are not asking whether you can afford the trip. They are asking whether you will return.
